__broaden__.αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.: ’which’ (with τε, in a simile) · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl., with γε: ’they, those’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl., with τε, of the Trojan women: ’who’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl., with κε + subj., of the Trojan women: ’those who may be’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl., without τε, of ships: ’which’ (αἵ οἱ ἕποντο ’which followed him’) · also relative, fem. nom. pl., with τε, continuing a list: ’those which’ (αἵ τ’ ἀπ’ ἐπισσώτρων ’and those from the tyres’)
__broaden__.γένηται: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a conditional clause after εἴ ποτε: ’if there ever comes to be’ · also in an indefinite relative clause with κε: ’proves, turns out’ (κρείσσων γένηται ’proves the stronger’) · also after ὅπως in an indirect question: ’how … may come about, turn out’ · also in a prohibition or negative wish after μή: ’let it not become’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a temporal clause after ἐπήν: ’has come to be’ (ἐπὴν τὰ πρῶτα γένηται ’once he has been born’) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a fear clause after δείδω μή: ’lest … come to be’
__broaden__.κελεύθου: κέλευθος — way, road, path; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation after ἀπόεικε: ’from the road’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation after χάζοντο: ’from the way’
__broaden__.πλευρῶν: Πλευρών — Pleuron, a city of Aetolia; fem. acc. sg., elided (Πλευρῶν’ = Πλευρῶνα) · also πλευρά — rib, side; fem. gen. pl.: ’(from) the ribs’
__broaden__.πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’)
__broaden__.σῶν: σῶς (σάος, σόος) — safe, sound; masc. acc. sg., contracted (σῶν = σόον): ’safe’ · also σός, σή, σόν (possessive) — your; neut. gen. pl. (σῶν ὀχέων ’your chariot’)
__broaden__.τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’)
__broaden__.ἀλέεινε: ἀλεείνω — avoid, shun, shrink from; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + inf.: ’shrank from’ · also impf. 3 sg., + acc.: ’avoided’ (ἀλέεινε μάχην ’avoided the fighting’)
